edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the provided owner to the owner state variable.
nominateNewOwner writes the argument into nominatedOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes nominatedOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets nominatedOwner to address(0).
acceptOwnership authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to nominatedOwner.
_onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner to gate privileged functions.
_onlyProxy compares msg.sender against proxy and integrationProxy.
_optionalProxy compares msg.sender with proxy addresses and messageSender.
_optionalProxy_onlyOwner authenticates msg.sender through messageSender and owner.
nominateNewOwner is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier invoking _onlyOwner.
setProxy is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier invoking _onlyOwner.
setIntegrationProxy is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier invoking _onlyOwner.
setTarget is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier invoking _onlyOwner.
setMessageSender is guarded by the onlyProxy modifier invoking _onlyProxy.
_optionalProxy_onlyOwner requires messageSender to equal the owner state variable.
Proxyable constructor stores the supplied address into proxy.
setProxy overwrites the proxy state variable.
setIntegrationProxy overwrites the integrationProxy state variable.
setMessageSender writes the forwarded sender into messageSender.
_optionalProxy may overwrite messageSender with the current caller.
_optionalProxy_onlyOwner may overwrite messageSender before the owner check.
Proxy constructor initializes the contract inherited from Owned.
setTarget updates the target state variable used by all delegated calls.
_emit feeds caller supplied calldata and topics into the assembly log operation.
Fallback externally calls target.setMessageSender, an outbound call into the target contract before forwarding the payload.
Fallback body executes the low-level call that forwards value and calldata.
Fallback reads msg.sender and passes it to the target as the message sender.
transfer forwards msg.sender to target.setMessageSender before the token call.
approve forwards msg.sender to target.setMessageSender before the token call.
transferFrom forwards msg.sender to target.setMessageSender before the token call.
transfer performs an external IERC20 call to the mutable target address.
approve performs an external IERC20 call to the mutable target address.
transferFrom performs an external IERC20 call to the mutable target address.
transfer reads the target state variable to resolve the callee and set the message sender.
approve reads the target state variable to resolve the callee and set the message sender.
transferFrom reads the target state variable to resolve the callee and set the message sender.
name delegates the view call to the target contract.
symbol delegates the view call to the target contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument _owner is only used to initialize Owned.owner inside the constructor.
nominateNewOwner argument _owner only feeds the nominatedOwner assignment.
Proxyable constructor argument _proxy is only assigned to the proxy state variable.
setProxy argument _proxy is only assigned to the proxy state variable.
setIntegrationProxy argument _integrationProxy is only assigned to integrationProxy.
setMessageSender argument sender is only assigned to messageSender.
setTarget argument _target is only assigned to the target state variable.
_emit argument callData is only consumed by the assembly log inside _emit.
_emit argument numTopics is only used to select the log opcode inside _emit.
balanceOf argument account is only forwarded to the target balanceOf call.
allowance argument owner is only forwarded to the target allowance call.
allowance argument spender is only forwarded to the target allowance call.
transfer argument to is only forwarded to the target transfer call.
transfer argument value is only forwarded to the target transfer call.
approve argument spender is only forwarded to the target approve call.
approve argument value is only forwarded to the target approve call.
transferFrom argument from is only forwarded to the target transferFrom call.
transferFrom argument to is only forwarded to the target transferFrom call.
transferFrom argument value is only forwarded to the target transferFrom call.
Local size is derived from callData.length and used only by the _emit assembly log.
Local free_ptr is scratch memory used only by the fallback forwarding routine.
Local result is the low-level call status checked only within the fallback.
